coffee-pub-curator.headingH2DeadTokens-Hint: When a player or creature dies, they will be replaced with a 'dead' version of their token.
coffee-pub-curator.deadTokenCreatureTypeFilter-Hint: Comma-separated creature types to apply dead tokens to for NPCs (leave empty for all). Example: humanoid,beast,dragon
coffee-pub-curator.deadTokenImagePath-Hint: Full path to dead token image for NPCs/Monsters (applied immediately at 0 HP).
coffee-pub-curator.deadTokenImagePathPC-Hint: Full path to dead token image for Player Characters (applied after 3 failed death saves).
coffee-pub-curator.headingH2LootTokens-Hint: When a player or creature dies, they will be replaced with a 'loot' version of their token.
coffee-pub-curator.tokenConvertDeadToLoot-Hint: Requires the module 'Item Piles' be installed and enabled.
coffee-pub-curator.tokenConvertDelay-Hint: How many seconds to wait before the loot is converted to a pile?
coffee-pub-curator.tokenLootPileImage-Hint: Full path to loot token image (applied after token converted to loot pile).
coffee-pub-curator.tokenLootChatMessage-Hint: Post a loot card to chat when a creature drops its belongings. The card carries the Loot button, which is the only way to open a corpse without canvas permission on its token, so turning this off removes that access path.
coffee-pub-curator.headingH3LootLooting-Hint: How players interact with a prepared corpse.
coffee-pub-curator.lootBuryApproval-Label: GM Approves Burying a Full Body
coffee-pub-curator.lootBuryApproval-Hint: Ask the GM before burying a body that still holds items or coins. An empty body is buried without asking. Turn this off to let anyone bury anything immediately, destroying whatever is left on it.
coffee-pub-curator.lootBuryWhenEmpty-Hint: Remove the token from the canvas automatically once the last item and coin have been taken.
coffee-pub-curator.lootProximity-Hint: How close a character must be to loot a body, in feet. Set to 0 for no distance requirement.
coffee-pub-curator.lootAllowInCombat-Hint: Allow bodies to be looted while a combat encounter is active. When off, looting is blocked until combat ends.
coffee-pub-curator.lootSendToParty-Hint: Show the controls that send loot to the party inventory. Requires a primary party to be set for the world.
coffee-pub-curator.lootSendToPlayer-Hint: Show the control that hands an item directly to another party member's character.
coffee-pub-curator.tokenLootTableGeneral-Hint: Choose a RollTable from any installed compendium.
coffee-pub-curator.tokenLootTableGear-Hint: Choose a RollTable from any installed compendium.
coffee-pub-curator.tokenLootTableTreasure-Hint: Choose a RollTable from any installed compendium.
coffee-pub-curator.tokenLootTableEpic-Hint: Choose a RollTable from any installed compendium.
coffee-pub-curator.tokenLootTableEpicOdds-Hint: Percentage chance that the epic loot table will be rolled. A value of 0 means it will never be rolled, a value of 1000 means it will always be rolled.
coffee-pub-curator.headingH2TokenImagePortraitReplacement-H: When tokens are dropped on the canvas, this module will automatically replace the token image with the best matching image from the cache.
coffee-pub-curator.headingH3TokenImageReplacementDataWeight: The weighting for the data used to calculate the best match for a token and portrait image replacement.
coffee-pub-curator.TokenImageReplacementIgnored-Hint: Comma-separated list of folder names to ignore when scanning. Applies to both token and portrait image replacement.
coffee-pub-curator.tokenImageReplacementFilterGarbageTags-H: Skip adding tags that look like dimensions (16X32), variant codes (001A, A1), or all-digit parts.
coffee-pub-curator.tokenImageReplacementThreshold-Hint: Lower values = more fuzzy matching, higher values = more exact matching.
coffee-pub-curator.tokenImageReplacementFuzzySearch-Hint: When disabled, searches for exact string matches.
coffee-pub-curator.tokenImageReplacementVariability-Hint: Randomly select from all images with the highest matching score.
coffee-pub-curator.headingH3PortraitImageReplacement-Hint: Automatically replace actor portrait images based on matching criteria.
coffee-pub-curator.portraitImageReplacementEnabled-Hint: Enable the portrait image replacement features and functions.
coffee-pub-curator.portraitImageReplacementUpdateDropped-Hi: When enabled, actor portraits will be automatically updated with the best matching portrait when tokens are created on the canvas.
coffee-pub-curator.portraitImageReplacementThreshold-Hint: Lower values = more fuzzy matching, higher values = more exact matching.
coffee-pub-curator.portraitImageReplacementFuzzySearch-Hint: When disabled, searches for exact string matches.
coffee-pub-curator.portraitImageReplacementVariability-Hint: Randomly select from all images with the highest matching score.
coffee-pub-curator.headingH2TileImagePlacement-Hint: Browse and place map/environment images as canvas tiles directly from the Blacksmith menubar.
coffee-pub-curator.headingH3TileImagePaths-Hint: Configure the folders that contain your tile and map images.
coffee-pub-curator.numTileImagePaths-Hint: How many folder paths to configure for tile images. Requires a reload to add or remove folders.
coffee-pub-curator.headingH3TileImageDefaults-Hint: These values are used as defaults when placing a tile from the browser. They can be overridden per-placement in the window.
coffee-pub-curator.tileDefaultAssetGridSize-Hint: The pixel size of one grid square in the source artwork. Tiles are auto-scaled so this maps to the scene's grid size. Example: set to 140 if your art was drawn at 140px per grid square.
coffee-pub-curator.tileDefaultRotation-Hint: Default rotation of placed tiles in degrees (0–359).
coffee-pub-curator.tileDefaultAlpha-Hint: Default opacity of placed tiles (0.1 = nearly invisible, 1.0 = fully opaque).
coffee-pub-curator.tileDefaultLocked-Hint: When enabled, placed tiles will be locked so they cannot be accidentally moved.
coffee-pub-curator.tileDefaultHidden-Hint: When enabled, placed tiles will be hidden from players until revealed by the GM.
coffee-pub-curator.tileDefaultElevation-Hint: Default elevation level for placed tiles.
coffee-pub-curator.headingH3TileImageSearch-Hint: Settings that control how tile images are searched and displayed in the browser.
coffee-pub-curator.tileImageFuzzySearch-Hint: When enabled, searches use fuzzy matching. When disabled, only exact string matches are returned.
coffee-pub-curator.tileImageTagSortMode-Hint: Controls how tags are sorted in the tile image browser.
coffee-pub-curator.tileImageCategoryStyle-Hint: Display category filters as buttons or tabs. Requires a reload to take effect.
